host.affinity: Darwin workstation, no sched affinity; bounded application workers; GOMAXPROCS is not a native CPU quota
host.powerBackground: Workstation default; no fixed-frequency or background isolation

scope: Fixed M4 observational event. Medians of five independent process means; all warm batches/pauses retained. Request percentiles computed within each process. Separate source-identical A/A aliases and resource cohort. No cross-host/cohort pooling or timing subtraction. Native C runs through the ordinary Go/LLGo C bridge and lacks VM safety contracts. Thread/RSS snapshots are idle observations, peak RSS through last pre-cleanup snapshot. Wasmtime/Wasmer concurrent, P3 I/O and full controlled release acceptance remain open.
